description: The file defines the 'MapVariable' class, which represents a dynamic key/value map of 'BaseVariable' types for Java and C code generation within a code generation framework. It includes methods for resolving references, generating encoding/decoding code in Java and C, and managing external dependencies. The class is part of a larger code generation system for device or service variables.

classes.name: MapVariable
classes.description: Represents a dynamic key/value map of 'BaseVariable' types, supporting code generation for Java and C, including resolving references and generating encode/decode code.

methods.name: getPossibleTypes
methods.description: Returns the list of supported variable types for the map.

methods.name: resolveReferences
methods.description: Resolves references and populates 'possibleTypes' based on the configuration.

methods.name: isMap
methods.description: Indicates that this variable represents a map.

methods.name: isPtr
methods.description: Indicates that the variable is a pointer type.

methods.name: getCtype
methods.description: Returns the C language type for this variable.

methods.name: getJavaType
methods.description: Returns the Java type for this variable.

methods.name: getValuesVarName
methods.description: Returns the variable name used for the map's values in generated code.

methods.name: getTypesVarName
methods.description: Returns the variable name used for the map's types in generated code.

methods.name: getJavaConstructorLines
methods.description: Generates Java code for initializing the map and types.

methods.name: getJsonKey
methods.description: Provides the JSON key name for this variable.

methods.name: getJavaGetter
methods.description: Generates Java getter methods for iterating keys, counting, and accessing specific types.

methods.name: getJavaSetter
methods.description: Generates Java setter methods for populating the map.

methods.name: getNativeGetter
methods.description: Creates C native functions to retrieve values from the map.

methods.name: getNativeSetter
methods.description: Creates C native functions to insert values into the map.

methods.name: getNativeEncodeLines
methods.description: Generates C code to encode the map into JSON based on variable types.

methods.name: getNativeDecodeLines
methods.description: Generates C code to decode JSON into the map, creating nested objects as needed.

methods.name: getJavaEncodeLines
methods.description: Generates Java code to encode the map into JSON.

methods.name: getJavaDecodeLines
methods.description: Generates Java code to decode JSON into the map.

methods.name: getJavaIpcObjectType
methods.description: Returns null, as MapVariable is not supported as IPC object type.
